runtime.actorGone: The tunnel service does not respond. Restart the app.
runtime.noLastStart: No parameters of a previous start: turn protection on again.
runtime.previousNotStopped: The previous connection did not stop. Disconnect and try again.
runtime.proxyAddressInvalid: Invalid upstream proxy address. Use host:port or [IPv6]:port; the port must be between 1 and 65535.
runtime.proxyNotListening: Proxy {{addr}} is unreachable. Make sure Happ runs in Proxy mode and listens on this port.
runtime.profileUnusable: This VPN profile cannot run in sing-box. Check the key or choose another server.
runtime.serverNotPreResolved: The server address was not found in advance: sing-box looks it up over DNS over HTTPS (1.1.1.1).
runtime.egressUnknown: Could not learn the external address through the VPN.
runtime.exitSilent: The server carried no traffic: the exit check got no answer. Try another server.
runtime.fullStopRan: Protection was already removed by a full stop
runtime.stopIncomplete: Disconnecting did not finish. Disconnect again.
runtime.restartStopFailed: The restart failed: the previous connection did not stop. Disconnect and connect again.
runtime.switchUnconfirmed: The new server did not confirm internet access.

tunSetup.adapter: The tunnel interface did not come up; the connection was cancelled.
tunSetup.protection: The kill switch was not confirmed. The start was cancelled.
tunSetup.routes: The tunnel interface could not be set up; the connection was cancelled. Details are in the log.

cleanup.exitUnproven: The VPN did not stop completely; network protection stays on. Disconnect again.
cleanup.xray: xray-core did not stop; protection stays on. Disconnect again.
cleanup.protection: The kill-switch firewall rules were not removed. Stop protection again and check the network diagnostics.

watchdog.proxyDown: Proxy {{addr}} does not respond; the internet is paused until it answers.
watchdog.upstreamDown: The VPN through server «{{name}}» does not respond; the internet is paused. Check the connection or choose another server.
watchdog.slotExited: The server's xray-core exited; restarting it.
